segments.he:
תּוֹרָה קלח
מִי שֶׁהוּא בַּר לֵבָב בִּבְחִינַת: "וְלִבִּי חָלַל בְּקִרְבִּי" (תְּהִלִּים קט, כב), יוּכַל לֵידַע עֲתִידוֹת עַל־יְדֵי מַה שֶּׁהַלֵּב אוֹמֵר לוֹ, שֶׁהוּא דִּבְרֵי ה' מַמָּשׁ:
segments.en: If one merits to truly feel the pain of one's sins — that is, when one circumcises the foreskin of one's heart until one truly feels the great pain of one's heart — and is pained and regrets and returns in genuine teshuvah — then all the hearts of all the drops that flowed from him will also feel it. Whether his actual children — or those drawn elsewhere — G-d forbid — all of them will have the foreskin of their heart circumcised. And they will feel where they are lying. And a great trembling will be made among them — and they will all be awakened to teshuvah.
